name: Insomnia
source:
You play as a gender-neutral high school student whose ordinary life takes a dark turn after getting caught up with the wrong crowd. As unsettling rumors spread, you come face to face with a mysterious man bearing a Glasgow smile.

INSOMNIA is a psychological horror short visual novel inspired by the classic Jeff the Killer Creepypasta, reimagining his backstory through an original protagonist.
translation:
你将扮演一名不限定性别的高中生，在误交损友之后，原本平淡的日常生活急转直下坠入深渊。随着令人不安的流言四处蔓延，你与一名嘴角裂开“格拉斯哥微笑”的神秘男子迎面相遇。

《Insomnia》是一部受经典都市恐怖怪谈“杀手杰夫”启发的短篇心理恐怖视觉小说，透过原创主角的视角重新构想了他的背景故事。
